dialogues.original: Trick or treat! I'm a wizard!

choices.answer: Can you do any magic tricks?

dialogues.original: Thank you! My dad helped me make the hat!

choices.answer: He did a great job! What's your favorite spell?
That's so sweet. Ready for candy?

dialogues.original: I can make candy disappear! Watch! *pretends to eat candy*

choices.answer: Haha! Very clever! Here's some real candy.
That's the best trick I've seen all night!

dialogues.original: But I wanna be a real wizard when I grow up!
Umm... Abracadabra? Oh! And Expecto Patronum!

choices.answer: A Harry Potter fan! Me too!

dialogues.original: Really?! Can I have extra candy then?

choices.answer: You earned it! Here you go!
